Card Q&A.a: Yes. As soon as your opponent no longer has an unsuspended Digimon in play, your attacking Digimon loses  from this card’s inherited effect.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent only has 1 unsuspended Digimon in play, and I attack with a Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards. When my opponent blocks and suspends their unsuspended Digimon, does my attacking Digimon immediately lose  from this card’s inherited effect?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] While your opponent has an unsuspended Digimon in play, this Digimon gains ＜Security Attack +1＞. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
